title: Ionisation enthalpy
basic_overview: IE generally rises across a period and falls down a group, with subshell and pairing exceptions.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Across: Z_eff wins; check s→p and pairing exceptions.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Identify removed e⁻. 2. Compare subshell. 3. Check pairing. 4. Compare Z_eff and n.
extra_info_content.factors: Be>B and N>O are classic first-IE anomalies.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
extra_info_content.exam_focus: Successive IE jump identifies the valence-electron count.
